messages:
People Ops: quick update — we launched a small reorg and a hiring round focused on inference capacity and runtime reliability. please read and RT if relevant :megaphone:
People Ops: new group: Capacity & Serving (consolidates parts of eng-runtime + eng-infra). goals: predictable throughput, cost controls, and rollout safety.
People Ops: immediate hires and moves:
• Samir Patel — Director, Capacity (external hire, starts Mon 5/12)
• Claire O'Neil — Sr Engineering Manager, Serving (external hire, starts 5/26)
• Aisha Khan — Product Manager, Capacity (internal transfer from product analytics, starts 4/29)
• Tom Becker — promoted to Head of Dedicated (internal promotion, effective today)
People Ops: a few ops notes: onboarding slots are booked in the calendar, access tickets (okta + infra) are in the queue, managers please confirm buddy/mentor within 48h. link to the onboarding board: https://go/redwood/onboard-capacity
Samir Patel: excited to join — hi everyone! i'll be focused on capacity planning, SLA definitions, and making Dedicated predictable. happy to meet 1:1s this week.
Claire O'Neil: hi team — looking forward to digging into runtime telemetry and batching improvements. shout if you want early access to the design doc.
Aisha Khan: will keep ownership of the capacity roadmap until Samir and Claire are fully onboarded — cc: @Tom Becker for Dedicated handoffs.
Tom Becker: pumped — big thanks to the folks who supported the promotion. i'll post a short handoff doc to #eng-runtime today.
Lizzy Mendoza: Congrats all! People Ops will run an intro all-hands next Wed 10am PT, calendar invite coming. pls review the org chart in the shared drive before then.
People Ops: action items for managers: 1) confirm access tickets 2) schedule 1:1 with new hires 3) assign onboarding buddy 4) add role to team README. ping @Lizzy if anything blocks.
Samir Patel: will schedule a team coffee on Friday. link: https://cal.com/samir/redwood-coffee — drop by for a quick intro. :coffee:
ops-bot: new hire checklist updated: okta ✅, git access pending, k8s namespace request filed.
Claire O'Neil: tiny ask — can infra grant batch-queue view to the new group? @eng-infra please.
Tom Becker: noted. i'll follow up with infra and drop links in the thread.
Lizzy Mendoza: thanks everyone. if there are concerns about headcount or backfill timing, DM me directly. we'll run an update in the weekly leadership sync. :raised_hands:
